q.en: What is included in your Perth milestone birthday packages?

a.en: Our packages cover concept styling, custom arches and signage, florals, catering and bar coordination, custom birthday cakes, furniture and glassware hire, DJ/lighting, and digital invitations with RSVP tracking.

q.en: Can you host a 30th, 40th or 50th birthday at a private residence or council hall?

a.en: Yes. Whether you are transforming your backyard in South Perth or hiring a community hall in Melville, Canning or Joondalup, we supply everything from marquees and tables to RSA bar staff.

q.en: How do you handle mixed dietary needs like Halal, Vegan and Gluten-Free at birthday parties?

a.en: Your digital invitation collects dietary tags for every guest. Our logistics bridge automatically separates Halal, Vegan, Vegetarian, Gluten-Free and severe allergy counts for the caterer.
